Assistant: I built the automation and tried it on your newest upload, "podcast episode 12.mp4". It worked, but it's switched off. [Open it](/automations/jn7a8qr3qd8n1x6dx5bkqv3kx18jcfre)

**What starts it:** each new video you upload. Audio and image uploads are ignored.

**What it does:** it makes two sets of clips from each recording, and each set gets captions.
- **TikTok:** cuts the video at pauses in speech into clips that fit TikTok's length limit and frame, then captions each clip.
- **YouTube Shorts:** does the same for Shorts.

**Caption look (my pick):** bold capitals, three words at a time, in the middle of the screen, with each word appearing as it's spoken. I can change this if you want a different style.

**The try:** it made 3 TikTok clips and 3 YouTube Shorts clips, and captioned all 6. No step failed. [See the run](/automations/jn7a8qr3qd8n1x6dx5bkqv3kx18jcfre/runs/jx7czpk25gbnmnc09vt13tx29d8jc118)

Should I switch it on so it runs on every new upload?
